text: {"327":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":["rustc_serialize"],"why":"rustc_middle defines the TyCtxt-aware encoder and decoder subtraits, while rustc_serialize only supplies their parent traits."},"328":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":["rustc_serialize"],"why":"The bound convention exists to serialize rustc_middle arena-allocated types, using serialization traits defined by rustc_serialize."},"329":{"about":["rustc_macros"],"refers":["rustc_middle"],"why":"rustc_macros implements the TyEncodable and TyDecodable derives that generate these implementations."},"330":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"This describes the difficulty of decoding rustc_middle arena-allocated types under Rust orphan rules."},"331":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle defines the RefDecodable trait as the workaround."}}
